snippet.title: Is Capitalism Broken? Nick Hanauer vs Jason Furman
snippet.description:
Capitalism has long been credited with driving innovation and prosperity, yet many Americans increasingly believe the system is no longer working for them. Is the problem capitalism itself or the policies surrounding it? In this debate, a billionaire and venture capitalist faces a prominent economist with a competing vision to examine inequality, economic opportunity, and the future of the American economy. Now we debate: Is Capitalism Broken?

Arguing Yes: Nick Hanauer, Entrepreneur and Venture Capitalist 

Arguing No: Jason Furman, Former Chairman of the Council of Economic Advisers; Professor at Harvard University’s John F. Kennedy School of Government 

Emmy award-winning journalist John Donvan moderates 

After you’ve watched the debate, let us know where you stand on the motion!
VOTE HERE: https://bit.ly/youtubecapitalismvote

We will reveal the results of the vote in our Substack newsletter on Saturday, September 5th, so make sure to subscribe: https://opentodebate.substack.com/
